name: meeting-scribe
description: Local Hebrew meeting recorder + transcriber (mic + system audio, ivrit.ai whisper)

scripts.build:calendar: swiftc -O -o swift/calendar-sidecar swift/calendar.swift -framework EventKit -framework Foundation -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker swift/Info.plist
scripts.build:ocr: swiftc -O -o swift/ocr-sidecar swift/ocr.swift -framework Vision -framework ImageIO -framework Foundation
scripts.build:diarize: swift build -c release --package-path swift/diarize && cp swift/diarize/.build/release/diarize-sidecar swift/diarize-sidecar
scripts.pack: npm run build:calendar && npm run build:audio && npm run build:audiosetup && npm run build:ocr && npm run build:diarize && electron-vite build && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-require-module electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.install:app: npm run pack && rm -rf '/Applications/Meeting Scribe.app' && cp -R 'dist.noindex/mac-arm64/Meeting Scribe.app' /Applications/

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Meeting Scribe records your microphone during meetings.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Meeting Scribe records the meeting audio played on this Mac so it can transcribe what other participants say.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Meeting Scribe reads your calendar to show upcoming meetings and prefill recording details.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Meeting Scribe reads your calendar to show upcoming meetings and prefill recording details.
